categories.description: Six public theorem/lemma declarations in Temporal/DenseMCS.lean lack individual /-- -/docstrings. categories.description: Five files from task 350 use file-global 'set_option linter.*' to suppress linters beyond the standard 'set_option linter.style.setOption false' (which is always needed when any set_option is present). Non-standard suppressions include: linter.style.show, linter.style.emptyLine, and linter.flexible in Bimodal/DeductionTheorem.lean (suggesting non-standard formatting choices); and global linter.dupNamespace false in Bimodal/GenericMCSBridge.lean, Temporal/GenericMCSBridge.lean, and Temporal/DenseMCS.lean (these should use per-declaration @[nolint dupNamespace] as DenseMCS.lean already does for Temporal.DerivFc and friends, rather than silencing the linter for the whole file). Global suppression masks any genuine dupNamespace violations that may be introduced later.

violations.issue: set_option linter.style.show false — non-standard global suppression; should be replaced with targeted @[nolint] or code reformatting
set_option linter.style.emptyLine false — non-standard; suppresses empty-line style checks for the whole file
set_option linter.flexible false — non-standard; suppresses flexible-syntax checks for the whole file
set_option linter.dupNamespace false (global) — should use per-declaration @[nolint dupNamespace] instead
set_option linter.dupNamespace false (global) — should use per-declaration @[nolint dupNamespace] instead
set_option linter.flexible false (global) — non-standard; the file already uses per-declaration @[nolint dupNamespace] for legitimate cases

categories.description: Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/GenericMCSBridge.lean is a documentation-only file (no Lean code) whose gap analysis states the temporal-style bridge 'could NOT be built for Modal logics', but a CORRECTION NOTICE added in lines 14-32 states the opposite conclusion. The file retains the old (incorrect) analysis with the correction embedded inside it, making the document self-contradictory and potentially misleading to contributors. The correct resolution is to either rewrite the file with the corrected understanding or delete the old analysis and keep only the updated conclusion.

violations.issue: CORRECTION NOTICE at lines 14-32 contradicts the gap analysis that follows it (lines 34-160). The file simultaneously claims the bridge cannot and can be built. The original gap analysis section headings (Component 1, 2, 3) should be updated or replaced; the CORRECTION NOTICE patch is insufficient.

The deduction-theorem characterization (DT iff MinimalHilbert) is a standard result with published proofs (e.g., Troelstra & Schwichtenberg, Basic Proof Theory); the citation should point to an authoritative source.
